052        public static enum RemnantSystemType {
053                DESTROYED(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_DESTROYED, "$remnantDestroyed"),
054                SUPPRESSED(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_SUPPRESSED, "$remnantSuppressed"),
055                RESURGENT(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_RESURGENT, "$remnantResurgent"),
056                ;
057                
058                private String tag;
059                private String beaconFlag;
060                private RemnantSystemType(String tag, String beaconFlag) {
061                        this.tag = tag;
062                        this.beaconFlag = beaconFlag;
063                }
064                public String getTag() {
065                        return tag;
066                }
067                public String getBeaconFlag() {
068                        return beaconFlag;
069                }
070        }

073        public static final int MIN_CONSTELLATIONS_WITH_REMNANTS = 15;
074        public static final int MAX_CONSTELLATIONS_WITH_REMNANTS = 25;
075        
076        public static float CONSTELLATION_SKIP_PROB = 0.25f;
077        
078

080                return Themes.REMNANTS;

083        @Override
084        public void generateForSector(ThemeGenContext context, float allowedUnusedFraction) {
085                
086                float total = (float) (context.constellations.size() - context.majorThemes.size()) * allowedUnusedFraction;
087                if (total <= 0) return;
088                
089                int num = (int) StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(MIN_CONSTELLATIONS_WITH_REMNANTS, MAX_CONSTELLATIONS_WITH_REMNANTS);
090                //num = 30;
091                if (num > total) num = (int) total;
092                
093                
094                int numDestroyed = (int) (num * (0.23f + 0.1f * random.nextFloat()));
095                if (numDestroyed < 1) numDestroyed = 1;
096                int numSuppressed = (int) (num * (0.23f + 0.1f * random.nextFloat()));
097                if (numSuppressed < 1) numSuppressed = 1;
098                
099                float suppressedStationMult = 0.5f;
100                int suppressedStations = (int) Math.ceil(numSuppressed * suppressedStationMult);
101                
102                WeightedRandomPicker<Boolean> addSuppressedStation = new WeightedRandomPicker<Boolean>(random);
103                for (int i = 0; i < numSuppressed; i++) {
104                        if (i < suppressedStations) {
105                                addSuppressedStation.add(true, 1f);
106                        } else {
107                                addSuppressedStation.add(false, 1f);
108                        }
109                }
110                
111                List<Constellation> constellations = getSortedAvailableConstellations(context, false, new Vector2f(), null);
112                Collections.reverse(constellations);
113                
114                float skipProb = CONSTELLATION_SKIP_PROB;
115                if (total < num / (1f - skipProb)) {
116                        skipProb = 1f - (num / total);
117                }
118                //skipProb = 0f;
119
120                List<StarSystemData> remnantSystems = new ArrayList<StarSystemData>();
121                
122                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("\n\n\n");
123                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Generating remnant systems");
124                
125                int count = 0;
126                
127                int numUsed = 0;
128                for (int i = 0; i < num && i < constellations.size(); i++) {
129                        Constellation c = constellations.get(i);
130                        if (random.nextFloat() < skipProb) {
131                                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Skipping constellation " + c.getName());
132                                skipProb -= 0.05f;
133                                continue;
134                        }
135                        
136                        
137                        List<StarSystemData> systems = new ArrayList<StarSystemData>();
138                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
139                                StarSystemData data = computeSystemData(system);
140                                systems.add(data);
141                        }
142                        
143                        List<StarSystemData> mainCandidates = getSortedSystemsSuitedToBePopulated(systems);
144                        
145                        int numMain = 1 + random.nextInt(2);
146                        if (numMain > mainCandidates.size()) numMain = mainCandidates.size();
147                        if (numMain <= 0) {
148                                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Skipping constellation " + c.getName() + ", no suitable main candidates");
149                                continue;
150                        }
151                        
152                        RemnantSystemType type = RemnantSystemType.RESURGENT;
153                        if (numUsed < numDestroyed) {
154                                type = RemnantSystemType.DESTROYED;
155                        } else if (numUsed < numDestroyed + numSuppressed) {
156                                type = RemnantSystemType.SUPPRESSED;
157                        }
158                        
159//                      if (type == RemnantSystemType.RESURGENT) {
160//                              System.out.println("ewfwefwefwe");
161//                      }
162                        context.majorThemes.put(c, Themes.REMNANTS);
163                        numUsed++;
164
165                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Generating " + numMain + " main systems in " + c.getName());
166                        for (int j = 0; j < numMain; j++) {
167                                StarSystemData data = mainCandidates.get(j);
168                                populateMain(data, type);
169                                
170                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_INTERESTING);
171                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT);
172                                if (type != RemnantSystemType.DESTROYED) {
173                                        data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_UNSAFE);
174                                }
175                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_MAIN);
176                                data.system.addTag(type.getTag());
177                                remnantSystems.add(data);
178
179                                if (!NameAssigner.isNameSpecial(data.system)) {
180                                        NameAssigner.assignSpecialNames(data.system);
181                                }
182                                
183                                
184                                if (type == RemnantSystemType.DESTROYED) {
185                                        RemnantSeededFleetManager fleets = new RemnantSeededFleetManager(data.system, 3, 8, 1, 2, 0.05f);
186                                        data.system.addScript(fleets);
187                                } else if (type == RemnantSystemType.SUPPRESSED) {
188                                        RemnantSeededFleetManager fleets = new RemnantSeededFleetManager(data.system, 7, 12, 4, 12, 0.25f);
189                                        data.system.addScript(fleets);
190
191                                        Boolean addStation = random.nextFloat() < suppressedStationMult; 
192                                        if (j == 0 && !addSuppressedStation.isEmpty()) addSuppressedStation.pickAndRemove();
193                                        if (addStation) {
194                                                List<CampaignFleetAPI> stations = addBattlestations(data, 1f, 1, 1, createStringPicker("remnant_station2_Damaged", 10f));
195                                                for (CampaignFleetAPI station : stations) {
196                                                        int maxFleets = 2 + random.nextInt(3);
197                                                        RemnantStationFleetManager activeFleets = new RemnantStationFleetManager(
198                                                                        station, 1f, 0, maxFleets, 25f, 6, 12);
199                                                        data.system.addScript(activeFleets);
200                                                }
201                                                
202                                        }
203                                } else if (type == RemnantSystemType.RESURGENT) {
204                                        List<CampaignFleetAPI> stations = addBattlestations(data, 1f, 1, 1, createStringPicker("remnant_station2_Standard", 10f));
205                                        for (CampaignFleetAPI station : stations) {
206                                                int maxFleets = 8 + random.nextInt(5);
207                                                RemnantStationFleetManager activeFleets = new RemnantStationFleetManager(
208                                                                station, 1f, 0, maxFleets, 15f, 8, 24);
209                                                data.system.addScript(activeFleets);
210                                        }
211                                }
212                        }
213                        
214                        for (StarSystemData data : systems) {
215                                int index = mainCandidates.indexOf(data);
216                                if (index >= 0 && index < numMain) continue;
217                                
218                                populateNonMain(data);
219                                
220                                if (type == RemnantSystemType.DESTROYED) {
221                                        data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_INTERESTING_MINOR);
222                                } else {
223                                        data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_INTERESTING);
224                                }
225                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT);
226                                //data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_UNSAFE); // just a few 1-2 frigate fleets, and not even always
227                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_SECONDARY);
228                                data.system.addTag(type.getTag());
229                                remnantSystems.add(data);
230                                
231                                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
232                                        RemnantSeededFleetManager fleets = new RemnantSeededFleetManager(data.system, 1, 3, 1, 2, 0.05f);
233                                        data.system.addScript(fleets);
234                                } else {
235                                        data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_NO_FLEETS);
236                                }
237                        }
238                        
239//                      if (count == 18) {
240//                              System.out.println("REM RANDOM INDEX " + count + ": " + random.nextLong());
241//                      }
242                        count++;
243                }
244                
245                SpecialCreationContext specialContext = new SpecialCreationContext();
246                specialContext.themeId = getThemeId();
247                SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecials(remnantSystems, specialContext);
248                
249                addDefenders(remnantSystems);
250                
251                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Finished generating remnant systems\n\n\n\n\n");
252                
253        }

257        public void addDefenders(List<StarSystemData> systemData) {
258                for (StarSystemData data : systemData) {
259//                      float prob = 0.1f;
260//                      float max = 3f;
261//                      if (data.system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_SECONDARY)) {
262//                              prob = 0.05f;
263//                              max = 1f;
264//                      }
265                        float mult = 1f;
266                        if (data.system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_SECONDARY)) {
267                                mult = 0.5f;
268                        }
269                        
270                        for (AddedEntity added : data.generated) {
271                                if (added.entityType == null) continue;
272                                if (Entities.WRECK.equals(added.entityType)) continue;
273                                
274                                float prob = 0f;
275                                float min = 1f;
276                                float max = 1f;
277                                if (Entities.STATION_MINING_REMNANT.equals(added.entityType)) {
278                                        prob = 0.25f;
279                                        min = 8;
280                                        max = 15;
281                                } else if (Entities.ORBITAL_HABITAT_REMNANT.equals(added.entityType)) {
282                                        prob = 0.25f;
283                                        min = 8;
284                                        max = 15;
285                                } else if (Entities.STATION_RESEARCH_REMNANT.equals(added.entityType)) {
286                                        prob = 0.25f;
287                                        min = 10;
288                                        max = 20;
289                                }
290                                // to compensate for this being changed to use fleet points
291                                min *= 3;
292                                max *= 3;
293                                
294                                prob *= mult;
295                                min *= mult;
296                                max *= mult;
297                                if (min < 1) min = 1;
298                                if (max < 1) max = 1;
299                                
300                                if (random.nextFloat() < prob) {
301                                        Misc.setDefenderOverride(added.entity, new DefenderDataOverride(Factions.REMNANTS, 1f, min, max, 4));
302                                }
303                                //Misc.setDefenderOverride(added.entity, new DefenderDataOverride(Factions.REMNANTS, prob, 1, max));
304                        }
305                }
306                
307        }

309        public void populateNonMain(StarSystemData data) {
310                if (DEBUG) System.out.println(" Generating secondary remnant system in " + data.system.getName());
311                boolean special = data.isBlackHole() || data.isNebula() || data.isPulsar();
312                if (special) {
313                        addResearchStations(data, 0.75f, 1, 1, createStringPicker(Entities.STATION_RESEARCH_REMNANT, 10f));
314                }
315                
316                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) return;
317                
318                if (!data.resourceRich.isEmpty()) {
319                        addMiningStations(data, 0.5f, 1, 1, createStringPicker(Entities.STATION_MINING_REMNANT, 10f));
320                }
321                
322                if (!special && !data.habitable.isEmpty()) {
323                        // ruins on planet, or orbital station
324                        addHabCenters(data, 0.25f, 1, 1, createStringPicker(Entities.ORBITAL_HABITAT_REMNANT, 10f));
325                }
326                
327                
328                addShipGraveyard(data, 0.05f, 1, 1,
329                                createStringPicker(Factions.TRITACHYON, 10f, Factions.HEGEMONY, 7f, Factions.INDEPENDENT, 3f));
330                
331                //addDebrisFields(data, 0.25f, 1, 2, Factions.REMNANTS, 0.1f, 1, 1);
332                addDebrisFields(data, 0.25f, 1, 2);
333
334                addDerelictShips(data, 0.5f, 0, 3, 
335                                createStringPicker(Factions.TRITACHYON, 10f, Factions.HEGEMONY, 7f, Factions.INDEPENDENT, 3f));
336                
337                addCaches(data, 0.25f, 0, 2, createStringPicker( 
338                                Entities.WEAPONS_CACHE_REMNANT, 4f,
339                                Entities.WEAPONS_CACHE_SMALL_REMNANT, 10f,
340                                Entities.SUPPLY_CACHE, 4f,
341                                Entities.SUPPLY_CACHE_SMALL, 10f,
342                                Entities.EQUIPMENT_CACHE, 4f,
343                                Entities.EQUIPMENT_CACHE_SMALL, 10f
344                                ));
345                
346        }

427        public List<StarSystemData> getSortedSystemsSuitedToBePopulated(List<StarSystemData> systems) {
428                List<StarSystemData> result = new ArrayList<StarSystemData>();
429                
430                for (StarSystemData data : systems) {
431                        if (data.isBlackHole() || data.isNebula() || data.isPulsar()) continue;
432                        
433                        if (data.planets.size() >= 3 || data.habitable.size() >= 1) {
434                                result.add(data);
435                                
436//                              Collections.sort(data.habitable, new Comparator<PlanetAPI>() {
437//                                      public int compare(PlanetAPI o1, PlanetAPI o2) {
438//                                              return (int) Math.signum(o1.getMarket().getHazardValue() - o2.getMarket().getHazardValue());
439//                                      }
440//                              });
441                        }
442                }
443                
444                Collections.sort(systems, new Comparator<StarSystemData>() {
445                        public int compare(StarSystemData o1, StarSystemData o2) {
446                                float s1 = getMainCenterScore(o1);
447                                float s2 = getMainCenterScore(o2);
448                                return (int) Math.signum(s2 - s1);
449                        }
450                });
451                
452                return result;
453        }
454        
455        public float getMainCenterScore(StarSystemData data) {
456                float total = 0f;
457                total += data.planets.size() * 1f;
458                total += data.habitable.size() * 2f;
459                total += data.resourceRich.size() * 0.25f;
460                return total;
461        }

464        public static CustomCampaignEntityAPI addBeacon(StarSystemAPI system, RemnantSystemType type) {
465                
466                SectorEntityToken anchor = system.getHyperspaceAnchor();
467                List<SectorEntityToken> points = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().getEntities(JumpPointAPI.class);
468                
469                float minRange = 600;
470                
471                float closestRange = Float.MAX_VALUE;
472                JumpPointAPI closestPoint = null;
473                for (SectorEntityToken entity : points) {
474                        JumpPointAPI point = (JumpPointAPI) entity;
475                        
476                        if (point.getDestinations().isEmpty()) continue;
477                        
478                        JumpDestination dest = point.getDestinations().get(0);
479                        if (dest.getDestination().getContainingLocation() != system) continue;
480                        
481                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(anchor.getLocation(), point.getLocation());
482                        if (dist < minRange + point.getRadius()) continue;
483                        
484                        if (dist < closestRange) {
485                                closestPoint = point;
486                                closestRange = dist;
487                        }
488                }
489                
490                CustomCampaignEntityAPI beacon = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().addCustomEntity(null, null, Entities.WARNING_BEACON, Factions.NEUTRAL);
491                //beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$remnant", true);
492                beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(type.getBeaconFlag(), true);
493                
494                switch (type) {
495                case DESTROYED: beacon.addTag(Tags.BEACON_LOW); break;
496                case SUPPRESSED: beacon.addTag(Tags.BEACON_MEDIUM); break;
497                case RESURGENT: beacon.addTag(Tags.BEACON_HIGH); break;
498                }
499                
500                if (closestPoint == null) {
501                        float orbitDays = minRange / (10f + StarSystemGenerator.random.nextFloat() * 5f);
502                        //beacon.setCircularOrbit(anchor, StarSystemGenerator.random.nextFloat() * 360f, minRange, orbitDays);
503                        beacon.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(anchor, StarSystemGenerator.random.nextFloat() * 360f, minRange, orbitDays);
504                } else {
505                        float angleOffset = 20f + StarSystemGenerator.random.nextFloat() * 20f;
506                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(anchor.getLocation(), closestPoint.getLocation()) + angleOffset;
507                        float radius = closestRange;
508                        
509                        if (closestPoint.getOrbit() != null) {
510//                              OrbitAPI orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbit(anchor, angle, radius, 
511//                                                                                                                              closestPoint.getOrbit().getOrbitalPeriod()); 
512                                OrbitAPI orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbitPointingDown(anchor, angle, radius, 
513                                                closestPoint.getOrbit().getOrbitalPeriod()); 
514                                beacon.setOrbit(orbit);
515                        } else {
516                                Vector2f beaconLoc = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
517                                beaconLoc.scale(radius);
518                                Vector2f.add(beaconLoc, anchor.getLocation(), beaconLoc);
519                                beacon.getLocation().set(beaconLoc);
520                        }
521                }
522                
523                Color glowColor = new Color(255,200,0,255);
524                Color pingColor = new Color(255,200,0,255);
525                if (type == RemnantSystemType.SUPPRESSED) {
526                        glowColor = new Color(250,155,0,255);
527                        pingColor = new Color(250,155,0,255);
528                } else if (type == RemnantSystemType.RESURGENT) {
529                        glowColor = new Color(250,55,0,255);
530                        pingColor = new Color(250,125,0,255);
531                }
532                Misc.setWarningBeaconColors(beacon, glowColor, pingColor);
533                
534                
535                return beacon;
536        }

541//      weights.put(LocationType.NEAR_STAR, 1f);

552        /**
553         * Sorted by *descending* distance from sortFrom.
554         * @param context
555         * @param sortFrom
556         * @return
557         */
558        protected List<Constellation> getSortedAvailableConstellations(ThemeGenContext context, boolean emptyOk, final Vector2f sortFrom, List<Constellation> exclude) {
559                List<Constellation> constellations = new ArrayList<Constellation>();
560                for (Constellation c : context.constellations) {
561                        if (context.majorThemes.containsKey(c)) continue;
562                        if (!emptyOk && constellationIsEmpty(c)) continue;
563                        
564                        constellations.add(c);
565                }
566                
567                if (exclude != null) {
568                        constellations.removeAll(exclude);
569                }
570                
571                Collections.sort(constellations, new Comparator<Constellation>() {
572                        public int compare(Constellation o1, Constellation o2) {
573                                float d1 = Misc.getDistance(o1.getLocation(), sortFrom);
574                                float d2 = Misc.getDistance(o2.getLocation(), sortFrom);
575                                return (int) Math.signum(d2 - d1);
576                        }
577                });
578                return constellations;
579        }

582        public static boolean constellationIsEmpty(Constellation c) {
583                for (StarSystemAPI s : c.getSystems()) {
584                        if (!systemIsEmpty(s)) return false;
585                }
586                return true;
587        }
588        public static boolean systemIsEmpty(StarSystemAPI system) {
589                for (PlanetAPI p : system.getPlanets()) {
590                        if (!p.isStar()) return false;
591                }
592                //system.getTerrainCopy().isEmpty()
593                return true;
594        }

598        public List<CampaignFleetAPI> addBattlestations(StarSystemData data, float chanceToAddAny, int min, int max, 
599                                                                                                WeightedRandomPicker<String> stationTypes) {
600                List<CampaignFleetAPI> result = new ArrayList<CampaignFleetAPI>();
601                if (random.nextFloat() >= chanceToAddAny) return result;
602                
603                int num = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
604                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("    Adding " + num + " battlestations");
605                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
606                        
607                        EntityLocation loc = pickCommonLocation(random, data.system, 200f, true, null);
608                        
609                        String type = stationTypes.pick();
610                        if (loc != null) {
611                                
612                                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createEmptyFleet(Factions.REMNANTS, FleetTypes.BATTLESTATION, null);
613                                
614                                FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, type);
615                                fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
616                                
617                                //fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE, true);
618                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_AGGRESSIVE, true);
619                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_JUMP, true);
620                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_ALLOW_DISENGAGE, true);
621                                fleet.addTag(Tags.NEUTRINO_HIGH);
622                                
623                                fleet.setStationMode(true);
624                                
625                                addRemnantStationInteractionConfig(fleet);
626                                
627                                data.system.addEntity(fleet);
628                                
629                                //fleet.setTransponderOn(true);
630                                fleet.clearAbilities();
631                                fleet.addAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER);
632                                fleet.getAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER).activate();
633                                fleet.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", 1000f);
634                                
635                                fleet.setAI(null);
636                                
637                                setEntityLocation(fleet, loc, null);
638                                convertOrbitWithSpin(fleet, 5f);
639                                
640                                boolean damaged = type.toLowerCase().contains("damaged");
641                                String coreId = Commodities.ALPHA_CORE;
642                                if (damaged) {
643                                        // alpha for both types; damaged is already weaker
644                                        //coreId = Commodities.BETA_CORE;
645                                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$damagedStation", true);
646                                        fleet.setName(fleet.getName() + " (Damaged)");
647                                }
648                                        
649                                AICoreOfficerPlugin plugin = Misc.getAICoreOfficerPlugin(coreId);
650                                PersonAPI commander = plugin.createPerson(coreId, fleet.getFaction().getId(), random);
651                                
652                                fleet.setCommander(commander);
653                                fleet.getFlagship().setCaptain(commander);
654                                
655                                if (!damaged) {
656                                        RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin.integrateAndAdaptCoreForAIFleet(fleet.getFlagship());
657                                        RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin.addCommanderSkills(commander, fleet, null, 3, random);
658                                }
659                                
660                                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
661                                
662                                
663                                //RemnantSeededFleetManager.addRemnantAICoreDrops(random, fleet, mult);
664                                
665                                result.add(fleet);
666                                
667//                              MarketAPI market = Global.getFactory().createMarket("station_market_" + fleet.getId(), fleet.getName(), 0);
668//                              market.setPrimaryEntity(fleet);
669//                              market.setFactionId(fleet.getFaction().getId());
670//                              market.addCondition(Conditions.ABANDONED_STATION);
671//                              market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_STORAGE);
672//                              ((StoragePlugin)market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_STORAGE).getPlugin()).setPlayerPaidToUnlock(true);
673//                              fleet.setMarket(market);
674                                
675                        }
676                }
677                
678                return result;
679        }
